overview.text: Today's artificial intelligence landscape highlights significant shifts across market valuations, developer tools, and foundational research. Notably, Anthropic IPO buyers are seeing valuations as low as 1.1T dollars, while practical concerns emerge as Claude Code sends user email addresses to websites. Concurrently, AI continues to dramatically accelerate its own research capabilities, alongside the introduction of Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash. In research and hardware analysis, new methods target robotic manipulation and LiDAR transformers, while evaluations of Huawei's Horinger data center reveal critical insights into regional compute gaps relative to leading global facilities. These developments collectively underscore an ecosystem rapidly maturing across economic, architectural, and security dimensions.

entries.title: SLA: Scaling Spatial-Language-Action Model via Continual Pre-training
entries.summary: Reliable robotic manipulation requires both semantic understanding and precise control in three-dimensional space.
entries.why: Advances reliable robotic manipulation by combining semantic understanding and precise spatial control.

entries.title: Towards Real-Time Full-Waveform LiDAR Transformers via Intensity-Guided Token Reduction and Physics-Aware Augmentation
entries.summary: LiDAR is a critical sensor for autonomous driving and robotics, yet it remains vulnerable to adverse conditions such as fog, rain, transparent objects, and low-reflectance surfaces.
entries.why: Improves autonomous driving sensor robustness under adverse weather and environmental conditions.

entries.title: StepX-OPD: Rethinking Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation in Diffusion Models
entries.summary: A deployable text-to-image diffusion model must hold several capabilities at once, such as instruction following, text rendering and human preference, and must sample in a few steps.
entries.why: Optimizes multi-teacher on-policy distillation for deployable text-to-image diffusion models.

entries.summary: A self-hosted retrieval-augmented search API: web search, content extraction, embeddings, and answer generation. · Python

entries.title: Teaching AI to build scientific models
entries.summary: AI for Science grantees Jakob Macke, Daniel Gedon, and Stefan Wahl on how AI is starting to change how scientific models are built and interpreted.
entries.why: Explores how artificial intelligence is fundamentally changing scientific model building and interpretation.

entries.title: The components of agent memory
entries.summary: For Claude to learn from experience, it has to decide what’s worth remembering before it knows what’s next. Here’s how “dreaming” helps it organize memory and correct mistakes.
entries.why: Examines agent memory architectures and how experience retention improves autonomous system performance.

entries.title: What Huawei’s Horinger data center reveals about China’s compute gap
entries.summary: Huawei’s AI data center in Horinger, Inner Mongolia, uses Ascend chips and has an estimated AI computing capacity that is just 7% that of the world’s largest AI data center, SpaceX’s Colossus 2 in Tennessee.
entries.why: Analyzes the hardware and compute capacity gap between Chinese data centers and global leaders.

entries.title: Quoting Nilay Patel
entries.summary: The products aren't good enough to sell people on the costs. You cannot tell people that you have to listen to the whine of a data center in their backyard for AI overviews and some of the most hilarious deep fake slop in history.
entries.why: Examines commercial viability challenges and public pushback regarding current AI product costs and utility.

entries.title: How big is the open model economy today?
entries.summary: Our first open model economy research note for paid subscribers.
